title: Ray-banned? Smart glasses, reels and the rulebook
description: For decades, wearing sunglasses indoors was the universal sign of someone who was either terribly hungover, aggressively untrustworthy or suffering from a severe case of unearned stardom.Then Big Tech did what Big Tech invariably does. It took a perfectly functional accessory, packed it with cameras, microphones, speakers, internet connectivity and generative AI, and sold it back to consumers as the future.Today, a pair of Ray-Ban Meta or Oakley smart glasses is no longer a niche gadget for tech
